description: Manage orders, after-sales, items, and logistics through the Xiaohongshu ARK e-commerce Open API.

fields.label: App ID
fields.description: The app ID (app-key) of a Xiaohongshu ARK open-platform app. Find it in the ARK console: https://ark.xiaohongshu.com/

fields.label: App Secret
fields.description: The app secret of the same ARK app, used to sign every request.

fields.label: Access Token
fields.description: The shop access token issued through the ARK OAuth flow or copied from the ARK console for self-developed merchant apps. Every business API requires it. Access tokens expire after 7 days; refresh with the refresh_token action or re-copy from the console.

fields.label: Refresh Token
fields.description: The refresh token issued together with the access token. It expires after 14 days and enables the refresh_token action; once it expires, the app must be re-authorized.

actions.name: adjust_sku_stock
actions.description: Increase or decrease the sellable stock of a Xiaohongshu SKU.

qty.description: The quantity to add when positive or remove when negative.

inputSchema.description: The stock adjustment for a Xiaohongshu SKU.

stock.description: A Xiaohongshu SKU stock result, including per-warehouse breakdowns.

actions.name: audit_after_sale
actions.description: Audit a Xiaohongshu after-sale request. Only callable while the after-sale is pending seller audit.

action.description: The audit decision: 1 to agree to a direct refund (refund-only requests), 2 to agree to a return shipment (not for refund-only requests), or 3 to reject.

reason.description: The reject reason ID from list_after_sale_reject_reasons. Required when action is 3.

description.description: The reject reason description. Required when the reject reason is other.

message.description: A message shown to the buyer when agreeing to a return shipment.

sellerAddressRecordId.description: The seller return address record ID. Required when agreeing to a return shipment.

droneSnCodes.description: The drone SN codes copied from the after-sale detail.

inputSchema.description: The audit decision for a Xiaohongshu after-sale request.

success.description: Whether Xiaohongshu accepted the audit decision.

actions.name: confirm_after_sale_receive
actions.description: Confirm receipt of a buyer-returned package for a Xiaohongshu after-sale. Only callable while the after-sale waits for seller receipt.

action.description: The receipt decision: 1 to confirm receipt, 2 to reject, or 3 to extend the wait.

reason.description: The reject reason ID from list_after_sale_reject_reasons. Required when action is 2.

droneSnCodes.description: The drone SN codes copied from the after-sale detail.

inputSchema.description: The receipt decision for a returned Xiaohongshu after-sale package.

success.description: Whether Xiaohongshu accepted the receipt decision.

actions.name: create_item
actions.description: Create a Xiaohongshu item with its SKUs. Typical setup order: list_categories, get_category_attributes, search_brands, list_carriage_templates, list_logistics_plans, then upload_material for the images.

categoryId.description: The leaf category ID, from list_categories.

shippingTemplateId.description: The carriage template ID, from list_carriage_templates.

shippingGrossWeight.description: The item shipping weight in grams. Required to be positive when the carriage template charges by weight.

link.description: The image URL returned by upload_material.

images.description: The main images. Upload files with upload_material first and pass each returned url as link.

logisticsPlanId.description: The logistics plan ID, from list_logistics_plans.

type.description: The delivery time type: 3 for same-day, 4 for relative hours, or 5 for an absolute time.

time.description: The delivery time value for the chosen type.

items.description: One SKU to create. Other upstream SKU fields such as originalPrice, variants, barcode, erpCode, and specImage pass through unchanged.

createSkuList.description: The SKUs to create. Each needs price (in fen), stock, logisticsPlanId (from list_logistics_plans), and deliveryTime ({ type, time }).

attributes.description: The category attributes, from get_category_attributes: { propertyId, name, value, valueId, valueList }.

variantIds.description: The spec type IDs of the item.

description.description: The item description, up to 500 characters.

deliveryMode.description: The delivery mode: 0 for normal delivery or 1 for no-logistics delivery.

videos.description: The main videos, in the same { link } shape as images.

imageDescriptions.description: The description images, in the same { link } shape as images.

inputSchema.description: The item and SKU data used to create a Xiaohongshu product.

item.description: A Xiaohongshu item record. Available fields depend on the query form.

actions.name: deliver_order
actions.description: Ship a Xiaohongshu order with an express tracking number. Supports split shipments by passing the SKU IDs of one package.

expressNo.description: The express tracking number, or the delivery content for no-logistics delivery.

expressCompanyCode.description: The express company code, as returned by list_express_companies. Use selfdelivery for no-logistics delivery.

expressCompanyName.description: The express company name. Matched from the code when omitted.

unpack.description: Whether this is a split shipment. Requires skuIdList.

skuIdList.description: The SKU IDs shipped in this package when unpack is true.

returnAddressId.description: The return address ID used for this shipment.

skuIdentifyCodeInfo.description: The device identification codes required by subsidy or drone orders.

inputSchema.description: The shipment details used to deliver a Xiaohongshu order.

actions.name: get_after_sale

inputSchema.description: The after-sale identifier used to retrieve a Xiaohongshu after-sale record.

afterSale.description: A Xiaohongshu after-sale record. Available fields depend on the after-sale status.

inputSchema.description: The leaf category whose attributes should be read.

items.description: A Xiaohongshu category attribute with its validation rules.

attributes.description: The attribute records with validation rules.

actions.name: get_item
actions.description: Get a Xiaohongshu item by its item ID, including its SKU list.

pageNo.description: The one-based page number of the SKU list.

pageSize.description: The number of SKUs per page.

item.description: A Xiaohongshu item record. Available fields depend on the query form.

items.description: A Xiaohongshu SKU record with price, stock, and logistics details.

skus.description: The SKU records of the item.

total.description: The total number of SKUs reported by Xiaohongshu.

actions.description: Get a Xiaohongshu order by its order ID, including SKU, amount, and delivery package details.

actions.name: get_order_receiver_info
actions.description: Get receiver addresses for Xiaohongshu orders. Only available while an order is pending shipment; call it right before printing shipping labels.

receiverQueries.description: Up to 20 receiver queries. Each needs the order ID and the openAddressId returned by get_order.

isReturn.description: Whether the query targets exchange orders instead of regular orders. Defaults to false.

inputSchema.description: The receiver queries used to retrieve Xiaohongshu order receiver information.

items.description: A Xiaohongshu order receiver record. Name, phone, and address are ciphertext until decrypted with the batch-decrypt API.

receivers.description: The receiver records, one per matched order.

actions.name: get_order_tracking
actions.description: Get the logistics tracking records of every package in a Xiaohongshu order.

items.description: A Xiaohongshu logistics package with tracking records.

packages.description: The logistics packages with tracking records.

actions.name: list_address_records

items.description: A Xiaohongshu after-sale reject reason option with reasonType, reasonId, and reasonName.

actions.name: list_after_sales
actions.description: List Xiaohongshu after-sale records by order or by creation/update time. Pass an order ID, or a time window (24 hours by creation time, 30 minutes by update time).

timeType.description: The time field to filter on: 1 for creation time or 2 for update time. Required with startTime and endTime when orderId is omitted.

statuses.description: The after-sale statuses to include: 1 pending audit, 2 pending buyer return, 3 pending seller receipt, 4 completed, 5 canceled, 6 closed, 9 audit rejected, 9001 receipt rejected, 12 exchange pending seller shipment, 13 exchange pending buyer confirmation, or 14 platform intervening.

returnTypes.description: The after-sale types to include: 1 return, 2 exchange, 4 refund only after shipment, 5 refund only before shipment, or 6 price protection.

pageNo.description: The one-based page number. Defaults to 1.

pageSize.description: The number of records per page. Defaults to 50 and cannot exceed 100.

inputSchema.description: The filters used to list Xiaohongshu after-sale records.

items.description: A Xiaohongshu after-sale record. Available fields depend on the after-sale status.

total.description: The total number of matching after-sale records reported by Xiaohongshu.

pageSize.description: The requested number of records per page.

pageSize.description: The number of carriage templates per page. Defaults to 20 and cannot exceed 100.

total.description: The total number of carriage templates reported by Xiaohongshu.

outputSchema.description: A paginated Xiaohongshu carriage template result.

pageNo.description: The one-based page number. Defaults to 1.

total.description: The total number of matching items reported by Xiaohongshu.

pageSize.description: The requested number of items per page.

actions.description: List the logistics plans of the Xiaohongshu shop. planInfoId is the logisticsPlanId used when creating SKUs.

inputSchema.description: No input is required to list logistics plans.

actions.name: list_materials
actions.description: List materials in the Xiaohongshu material center, for example to check an upload status.

pageSize.description: The number of materials per page. Defaults to 50 and cannot exceed 500.

actions.name: list_orders
actions.description: List Xiaohongshu orders by creation or update time. startTime and endTime are Unix timestamps in seconds, while the returned order times are in milliseconds. Creation-time windows are limited to 24 hours and update-time windows to 30 minutes.

timeType.description: The time field to filter on: 1 for creation time or 2 for update time.

orderType.description: The order type: 0 for all, 1 for in-stock, 2 for deposit presale, 4 for full-payment presale, or 5 for exchange reshipment.

orderStatus.description: The order status: 0 for all, 1 unpaid, 2 paid processing, 3 in customs clearance, 4 pending shipment, 5 partially shipped, 6 shipped, 7 completed, 8 closed, 9 canceled, or 10 exchange requested.

pageSize.description: The number of records per page. Defaults to 50 and cannot exceed 100.

items.description: A Xiaohongshu order record. Available fields depend on the order type.

total.description: The total number of matching orders reported by Xiaohongshu.

pageSize.description: The requested number of orders per page.

items.description: A Xiaohongshu supported customs port with customs_name and customs_code.

actions.name: modify_order_express

expressCompanyCode.description: The Xiaohongshu express company code, as returned by list_express_companies.

oldExpressNo.description: The tracking number to replace. Takes precedence over deliveryOrderIndex and rewrites every package using it.

expressUrlProofList.description: The new delivery links for automatically delivered orders.

inputSchema.description: The express update for a shipped Xiaohongshu order.

actions.name: modify_order_remark

inputSchema.description: The seller remark update for a Xiaohongshu order.

actions.name: refresh_token
actions.description: Refresh the access token using the refresh token stored in the connection credential. Xiaohongshu only issues new tokens when the access token has under 30 minutes left or has expired; otherwise it returns the current ones unchanged. A changed token set must be saved back to the connection, and the old access token stays valid for only 5 more minutes. Access tokens expire after 7 days.

inputSchema.description: No input is required to refresh the token; the refresh token comes from the connection credential.

token.description: The token record with accessToken, accessTokenExpiresAt, refreshToken, refreshTokenExpiresAt, sellerId, and sellerName.

actions.name: resend_payment_record
actions.description: Ask Xiaohongshu to notify the payment company to push the payment record to customs again for a bonded cross-border order.

customsType.description: The customs system to push to.

inputSchema.description: The order whose bonded payment record should be pushed again.

message.description: The result message returned by Xiaohongshu.

items.description: A Xiaohongshu item record. Available fields depend on the query form.

pageSize.description: The requested number of items per page.

stock.description: A Xiaohongshu SKU stock result, including per-warehouse breakdowns.

categoryId.description: The leaf category ID, from list_categories.

shippingTemplateId.description: The carriage template ID, from list_carriage_templates.

shippingGrossWeight.description: The item shipping weight in grams. Required to be positive when the carriage template charges by weight.

images.description: The main images. Upload files with upload_material first and pass each returned url as link.

skuId.description: The SKU ID, from list_item_skus or get_item.

logisticsPlanId.description: The logistics plan ID, from list_logistics_plans.

type.description: The delivery time type: 3 for same-day, 4 for relative hours, or 5 for an absolute time.

time.description: The delivery time value for the chosen type.

updateSkuList.description: The existing SKUs to update. Each needs skuId, price (in fen), stock, logisticsPlanId (from list_logistics_plans), and deliveryTime ({ type, time }).

logisticsPlanId.description: The logistics plan ID, from list_logistics_plans.

type.description: The delivery time type: 3 for same-day, 4 for relative hours, or 5 for an absolute time.

time.description: The delivery time value for the chosen type.

items.description: One SKU to create. Other upstream SKU fields such as originalPrice, variants, barcode, erpCode, and specImage pass through unchanged.

createSkuList.description: The new SKUs to add to the item, in the same shape as updateSkuList without skuId.

deleteSkuIdList.description: The SKU IDs to remove from the item.

attributes.description: The category attributes, from get_category_attributes: { propertyId, name, value, valueId, valueList }.

variantIds.description: The spec type IDs of the item.

description.description: The item description, up to 500 characters.

deliveryMode.description: The delivery mode: 0 for normal delivery or 1 for no-logistics delivery.

videos.description: The main videos, in the same { link } shape as images.

imageDescriptions.description: The description images, in the same { link } shape as images.

inputSchema.description: The item and SKU data used to update a Xiaohongshu product.

item.description: A Xiaohongshu item record. Available fields depend on the query form.
